title: War and Peace: A Source-Generated Terminal Theorem

additional_titles.title: 战争与和平的源生终局定理

description:
This paper proves constructive completeness of peace for open social worlds, establishing impossibility theorems and exact characterisations across five institutional boundaries. In the responsibility-reattachment comparison, conflict destroys material. The initiator gains when the shifted liability exceeds the destruction they bear. Once spendable capacity falls below the least eliminating rate, no ex post liability rate deters war (judgment-proof obstruction), while under incomplete observation a single prior policy's optimal guarantee equals the infimum of local observation-fibre suprema and is attained iff every binding fibre attains it. Under the old single-signature compiler erasing cross-community consent, unilateral return credits nothing whereas a cross-community receipt opens an equal reverse debt at the position it clears, keeping total unpaid reparation non-decreasing; the damage guard forwards exactly the lawful zero-damage requests as the widest safe admission. Without priority scheduling, zero-material stop inputs stall a lodged withdrawal forever within bounded time; priority yields sharp completion and anti-filibuster hourly progress bounds, and crossing an emergency hard deadline bars grants across all suffixes. For arbitrary participants, goods, technologies, and admitted histories, sustainable joint settlement holds iff the viable clearing domain is nonempty, attaining minimum visits. Verified post-settlement stock directly opens open-syntax peaceful continuation: zero-debit policy proposals can strip personal exits under an unchanged old quote word and evade any given finite adaptive duration query tree via out-of-sample alteration—ruling out static and finite-sample classifiers; dynamic prepaid verification triggers minimal semantic extensions that strictly shrink unsealed vulnerabilities, preserve every native word, impose strict net losses on overreaching or proxy probes, and erase zero-fee probes. Pending signatures, shortages, and delayed evidence are handled by paid due continuation, width-complete recipe search, and receipt transport.

At the execution layer, safe stock-identical permuted replays refute snapshot criteria, and each parent head uses 3f + 1 = 4 (f = 1) quorum intersection, certifying handovers by three outgoing votes and four incoming source replays. Role-seal fault budgets pre-check maximal obtainable evidence first, and before replay completes, three honest outgoing seals dispose of stalled attempts without deadlock even if 0/4 nominees respond. Under reliable exclusion and exclusion-gated vote changes, arbitrarily many handovers, withdrawals, and reassignments keep finite certified histories prefix-comparable and infinite continuations identical at every index across possibly disjoint rosters; the same six-unit ledger runs continuously through productive settlement, two language revisions, deployed staging, cold recovery, and four-host handovers from clock 12 to clock 28.

additional_descriptions.description:
本文证明开放社会世界的构造性和平完备性，并沿五道制度边界给出解释各项条件为何缺一不可的不可能性定理与充要判据。在责任回接比较中，冲突造成净物量损失，决策者的私人优势来自转嫁责任超过其承担的损毁。当施害方的可支用偿付上限低于最小止战回接率时，任何事后赔偿比例均无法消除开战诱因（破产免责阻塞）；不完全观察下单一事前策略的最优保证等于各观察纤维局部保证的下确界，实达当且仅当所有绑定纤维实达。在抹去跨界同意的旧单签编译下，施害人单签归还不减旧债，跨界单签收据则在销掉旧债的同一物量位置开出等额反向新债，使跨界未清总追偿沿任意续行单调不减；损害门禁精确放行全部原合法零新损请求，构成最宽安全准入。无优先调度时，零物量停止请求即可将已交撤权无限挂起在有界时段内；安装优先队列给出紧访问界与反拉布整点生计推进界，应急硬期限越界后沿任意后缀永久禁绝提名、接受与续任。对任意参与者、物量、技术与原准入历史，可持续联合清偿成立当且仅当可续全账清偿域非空并取得最少访问。清偿后的真实库存经核验直接开启开放语法和平运行：零跨界扣料的政策改订可在保持旧报价词不变时剥夺个人独立退出，且对任意给定的有限自适应时长查询树均存在越界篡改反例，排除了静态与有限抽样分类器；在实际扣费前态动态核验已付暴露，方能以最小语义扩张严格缩小未封闭脆弱面、精确保持任意原生词编译，令付费越权或代理投单严格净亏损，并将零费试探整轨擦除。等待签收、生产短缺和迟到证据分别由实付续行、完整宽度搜索和原收据运输处理。

执行层先以每拍库存与时钟全同的无损异序反例排除快照判据，再在每个父账头采用 3f + 1 = 4 (f = 1) 交集几何，由旧届三签表决与新届四人从原源复演共同认证换届。半途失联时按角色封印强迫违约集逐届核验故障预算，发封前先检最大可得证据，且复演未齐时即便拟新届全员失联，三份诚实旧届未表决封印仍可无死锁排除候选。在有效排除可靠及改签须凭排除的条件下，任意多次换届、撤回与改派保持有限认证历史前缀可比、无限续行逐拍一致，相邻名单可以完全不相交。同一六单位原账贯穿增产清偿、两次语言修订、九阶段部署轨道及四物理节点钟12–28的冷恢复与换届运行。

English and Chinese manuscripts and technical supplements, plus editable source. The fixed H0mework proof selection covers PE1–PE33. The original certified journal can be replayed offline through clock 28. Text and figures are available under CC BY 4.0. The public Lean project uses Apache-2.0.
